Looking at the strange city in front of me, it is not too big. It is like a huge fortress. It is floating hundreds of feet above the sea. The four spurting water drops are pushing against the four corners of the city, making the city float safely. Hundreds of feet above the sea. Looking at the young guard's reply, Li Ningyu suddenly became meaningful and absorbed the young guard's words. After a few seconds, Li Ningyu asked the guard: "What is your name?" However, after the iron soldiers led the charge, they suddenly discovered that the number of enemies was far more than that. There were about a thousand people in a battalion, not 300 people at all. This is the same for everyone. "By the way, do you know why all the ancient fighting emperors have disappeared?" Qian Mo pretended not to know and asked. This was also the question of everyone in Xukun. As more and more people expressed their opinions, an idea suddenly appeared in everyone's mind. Lin Yun grabbed one of his arms in the air, and then slowly pulled it out. Only this time, a golden sword appeared in the arm.
